lines.zh: 我趴得很低，肚子擦着泥
lines.en: I keep low, belly to the mud.

lines.zh: 我的尾巴在身后拖出一道沟
lines.en: My tail drags a groove behind me.
I shift toward the water, step by step.
I take my time turning.

lines.zh: 装甲一样的背掠过芦苇
lines.en: My armoured back parts the reeds.
I crawl into the shallows of the bend.
My four feet sink into the mud.
I move along the shoreline.

lines.zh: 我每挪一步，水面就动一下
lines.en: Each step I take moves the water.
I crawl across a gravel bar.
My head stays toward the water.

lines.zh: 我慢慢把身子挪进水里
lines.en: I slide my body into the water.

lines.zh: 我沿着河道的弯慢慢转
lines.en: I ease around the river's bend.

lines.zh: 我爬过一截倒下的树干
lines.en: I crawl over a fallen trunk.
Only my eyes and back show.
I look like a sunken log.
My jaws are open, waiting.
Ripples spread from me.
I have lain here most of the day.
My breathing barely makes bubbles.

lines.zh: 我不动的时候最像石头
lines.en: Still, I look most like a stone.
I know how this river tastes.
I wait for something to come drink.
My tail sways gently.
I blink only once in a long while.
I have not moved an inch.
The sun lies on my back.
The fish here are too small.
You stand at the water's edge, too close.
I lift my head and break the surface.
I am far longer than you think.
Your legs look very fine in the water.

lines.zh: 九米的鳄，趴在岸边像根木头。
lines.en: A nine-meter croc lying like a log on the bank.
You cannot guess my weight.

lines.zh: 我身上的鳞比你的甲硬
lines.en: My hide is harder than your armour.
Do not bend to drink.
I have waited here a long while.
Only water lies between us.
I raise my head and measure you.
My scales are cut open.
I pull half my body back.
I roll once in the mud.
That bite hurt me.
I slap the water with my tail.
Blood thins away in the river.
My jaws can still bite.

lines.zh: 装甲鳞片被敲出了一道白印。
lines.en: A white mark is dented into my armored scutes.
This smell is blood.
I edge toward it.
Lower that thing down.
Anything alive; I am not picky.
I come up out of the water.
You are dangling a hook for me.
I will not touch carrion.
Reach that arm a little further.
You bumped into my armoured back.
I did not give an inch.
You sit down from the impact.
My tail sweeps across your legs.

lines.zh: 你的脚正踩在我的尾巴上
lines.en: Your foot is on my tail.
We churn the surface open.
I slide past your feet.
That should have pushed you off.
My hide scrapes your hand.
Do not walk beside the bank.
The eggs must go in a sand bank.
This bank is big enough for two.
I watch the water, she watches the bank.
We need do nothing.
My mate can wait longer than I can.
The nest must be buried deep.
The rising water will reach it.
I hate being interrupted most of all.
When she moves, I move.
We swim side by side, slowly.
What falls into the water is mine.
I snap it up in one bite.
This is too hard to bite through.
I press it into the riverbed mud.
I flick it over with my tail.
Whosever it is, I will not give it back.

lines.zh: 猎物卡在牙缝里，我慢慢磨。
lines.en: The prey is stuck between my teeth; I grind slowly.
That little bit is nowhere near enough.
I drag it into deep water.
I swallow it without asking.
You came onto my bank.
I turn my head toward you.
You are standing in the water, good.
My jaws are already open.
Do not run for the bank.
This bank is mine.
You are too close to the water.
I spent half a day preparing that bite.
I sink until only my eyes show.
I am right under your feet.

lines.zh: 你看不见我，我看得见你
lines.en: You cannot see me; I see you.
I wait for you to come a little further.
My long tail is set.
The mud under you is giving way.
I am in no hurry to bite.

lines.zh: 我潜到水底，只露出鼻孔。
lines.en: I sink to the bottom, nostrils barely breaking the surface.
Your feet are sinking.
I know this stretch of riverbed.
I am at your flank.
You only need to bend once more.
My jaws have closed.
My teeth go through your armour.
My jaws drag you into the water.
I roll, and the ground shakes.
That bite waited half a day.
Your bones make a sound.
Once I bite, I do not let go.
You pulled free of my teeth.
That should stick with you.
I retreat back into the water.
Blood reddens the bank.
My teeth have gone a little blunt.
I rise from the riverbed.
A stretch of back breaks the surface.
This bend finally looks right.
I crawl onto the sand bank.
I swam down from upstream.
I found a spot in the mud.
I flatten a patch of reeds.
The water here is murky enough.
I settle, and become the bank.
I raise my head to look at the river.
Every bird here has flown off.

lines.zh: 我吐出一口气，水面动了
lines.en: I exhale, and the water stirs.
I am here, and it goes quiet.
My first string of bubbles.
I took the deepest pool.
I curl my tail around.
Fire bites my armoured back.
I slide off the bank into the water.
I sank too deep, and cannot hold my breath.

lines.zh: 爆炸把水掀起来，我翻了个身
lines.en: The blast lifts the water and rolls me over.

lines.zh: 一支箭钉在我的背甲上
lines.en: An arrow sticks in my armoured back.
Magic burns along my seams.
There are no big fish left in this river.

lines.zh: 雷落在水面上，我周身一紧
lines.en: Lightning strikes the water and everything in me tightens.
The water and mud are gone.
